title: Global flatness at a stage from a persistent open cover
statement: Let Λ be a nonempty directed preorder and A,B:Λ to CommRing and D:Λ to AddCommGrp functors [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give D_i a B_i-module structure, and choose ring maps φ_i:A_i to B_i. Let S be a commutative ring and κ:B to const(S) a colimit cocone. Suppose U_i are open subsets of Spec(B_i) [def-weil-affine-spectrum], every q in U_i has D_i localized at q flat over A_i along φ_i [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and for i≤j the inverse image of U_i along Spec(B_j) to Spec(B_i) is contained in U_j. Assume every prime q of S has its contraction along κ_i in U_i for some i. Then some D_i, restricted along φ_i, is flat over A_i. No finiteness, transition base-change, limit-flatness, or compatibility of the φ_i is required: these are only used elsewhere to supply the specified open cover.

source.place: Tag 02JO (1), proof second and third paragraphs

proof.text: Pull U_i back by Spec(κ_i) to V_i in Spec(S). Continuity makes V_i open. Cocone naturality identifies contraction through a transition with direct contraction, and persistence gives V_i contained in V_j for i≤j. Directedness and the pointwise covering therefore give a directed open cover. Compactness of Spec(S) selects i with V_i all Spec(S).

Write the closed complement of U_i as V(J) using the closed-set ideal characterization in Spec(B_i). If the extension of J to S lay in a prime q, its contraction would lie in V(J), contradicting V_i containing all Spec(S). The empty-zero-locus criterion implies the extension of J is the unit ideal.

Prove elementwise descent of membership in the extended ideal by induction on its span: an image generator already lifts at i; zero lifts at i; addition takes a common upper bound of the two representatives; scalar multiplication first lifts its coefficient from S by the ring-colimit representative theorem, then takes a common upper bound. Functor and cocone naturality give equality with the limit element. Apply the result to 1 in the extended unit ideal. Its stage representative equals 1 in S, so the eventual-equality criterion descends this equality to a later stage. The transported ideal then contains 1, hence is the unit ideal.

For a prime of that later stage, persistence and the description of the closed complement show that being outside U_j would force the prime to contain the transported ideal J, now the unit ideal. Thus all primes lie in U_j and all corresponding module localizations are flat over A_j. Install the restricted A_j-module action, its scalar tower with B_j, and compare the two restricted localization actions by equality on fractions. Apply Module.flat_of_isLocalized_maximal to the canonical localized-module maps at maximal ideals, obtaining D_j flat over A_j.

theorem exists_flat_finiteType_approximation_stage
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S]
    (A B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (D : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v})
    [∀ i : Λ, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)]
    (φ : ∀ i, A.obj i →+* B.obj i)
    (κ : B ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of S))
    (hc : IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of S) κ))
    (U : (i : Λ) → Set (PrimeSpectrum (B.obj i)))
    (hUopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hUflat : ∀ i (q : PrimeSpectrum (B.obj i)), q ∈ U i →
      letI : Module (A.obj i) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (D.obj i)) :=
        Module.compHom _ (φ i)
      Module.Flat (A.obj i) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (D.obj i)))
    (hUpersist : ∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j),
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom ⁻¹' U i ⊆ U j)
    (hUcover : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S, ∃ i, PrimeSpectrum.comap (κ.app i).hom q ∈ U i) :
    ∃ i : Λ, letI : Module (A.obj i) (D.obj i) := Module.compHom (D.obj i) (φ i)
      Module.Flat (A.obj i) (D.obj i)
